body_text:
Cauchy's integral formula. Under the corresponding disk or
winding-number hypotheses, if $z_0$ lies inside a positively
oriented simple closed contour $\gamma$, then
$f(z_0)=\frac{1}{2\pi i}\int_\gamma
\frac{f(z)}{z-z_0}\,dz$. Differentiating the formula yields
$f^{(n)}(z_0)=\frac{n!}{2\pi i}\int_\gamma
\frac{f(z)}{(z-z_0)^{n+1}}\,dz$.
